remarks: Welcome to this well-maintained 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse offering the perfect blend of comfort, space, and convenience in Stamford. With a thoughtfully designed multi-level layout, this home provides the privacy and feel of single-family living while remaining close to everything the city has to offer.  The bright and inviting living areas create a warm and welcoming atmosphere, while the spacious bedrooms provide a comfortable retreat at the end of the day. Whether you're working from home, entertaining guests, or simply relaxing, this townhouse offers a functional layout designed to fit a variety of lifestyles.  Parking is made easy with one dedicated off-street parking space, along with additional first-come, first-served parking available within the property for added convenience.  Conveniently located just minutes from downtown Stamford, shopping, restaurants, parks, public transportation, and major highways, you'll enjoy easy access to work, entertainment, and everything the city has to offer.  Offered at $2,650 per month, this is an excellent opportunity to enjoy townhouse living in one of Stamford's most convenient locations.  Tenant is responsible for all utilities.
